scope: Stock private REST only. External preflight/bulk preparation precedes FE launch. Independent verification follows FE sampling. Actual observer pages/names/body bytes/concurrent requests are distinct from SDK positions and FE allocator bytes. No deterministic boundary injection, cross-provider acceptance, native deadline extension, or retry.
deadline_scope: Native SQL/provider phases and native resource convergence must finish before one fixed1800s deadline (also clamped to context.deadline). External prelaunch preparation and post-native read-only verification each use their separately frozen producer clocks; verification is not included in native phase PASS or FE sampling.
